atAGlance: Cơm niêu is clay-pot rice, usually with crisp rice edges, fluffy center, and shared savory dishes.
whatItIs: Cơm niêu is clay-pot rice, served hot with a crisp bottom or edges and meant to accompany shared dishes. The rice itself is the attraction.
howToEnjoy: Scrape some crisp rice edge with the soft rice, then eat it alongside braised fish, vegetables, or soup. Order shared dishes if the menu lists cơm niêu as plain rice.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm niêu when you want the clay-pot rice experience. Ask what dishes come with it, because some shops sell the rice alone and others serve a full set.
worthKnowing: The joy is texture: soft rice in the middle, toasted edges near the pot, and family-style dishes around it.
goodToKnow: Ask what comes with the clay-pot rice. Some places serve a full shared set, while others expect you to choose braised fish, vegetables, or soup separately.
